verificationSummary: Editor commit 6f59f7269322abfe3428d4df6f4ba0ee6ab0078f adds a bounded visible text-block textarea island and proves it through a live local Backend browser smoke. The source boundary stores sourcePackageValue on the Editor working set only for Backend api and mutation-result transport envelopes, then textBlockInlineDraftAdapter exposes a ready draft only for package 3/document 4 text-block children with at least one text inline run. Fixture/local-draft package sources, package 2/document 3, missing package data, non-text-block targets, invalid inline children, and field-ref-only inline children return blocked reasons. useActiveTextBlockEditing opens the active island for the selected ready text block, keeps typed draft text in activeTextBlockIsland, marks IME composition active/inactive, commits only on explicit Save or Ctrl+Enter, cancels on Cancel or Escape, and gates Save while node mutation, add-node mutation, document migration, or another text-block commit is pending. PaperTextBlockEditor renders the selected ready text block as a textarea with Save text block and Cancel text edit icon buttons, never renders contenteditable, keeps ordinary paper blocks as keyboard-reorderable buttons, protects canvas selection and pointer drag from textarea/editor button events, and focuses an active textarea before falling back to a paper block control. The live browser smoke starts real Editor and Backend loopback servers, migrates the seeded product-report-vnext-minimal document, selects title, types Updated through visible text block editor, clicks Save, observes text-block.rich-inline.replace, reloads the route from Backend api r7 with the committed text, verifies contentEditableCount 0, then reorders title and observes mutation-result r8. RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/textBlockInlineDraftAdapter.test.ts failing because textBlockInlineDraftAdapter was missing, npm run test -- src/tests/activeTextBlockEditingHook.test.ts failing because useActiveTextBlockEditing was missing, npm run test -- src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/canvasInteractiveTarget.test.ts failing because PaperTextBlockEditor and canvasInteractiveTarget were missing, and npm run test -- src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts failing because the retained fixture did not yet contain text-block typing evidence. Focused GREEN evidence passed npm run test -- src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockIslandCommitRunner.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockEditingHook.test.ts; npm run test -- src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/canvasInteractiveTarget.test.ts src/tests/paperSmoothZoomSurface.test.ts; npm run test -- src/tests/canvasKeyboardReorderFocus.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts src/tests/canvasInteractiveTarget.test.ts src/tests/paperSmoothZoomSurface.test.ts; and npm run test -- src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts src/tests/liveCompatibilityHarness.test.ts. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, Vitest with 102 test files and 350 tests, and build. Merged Editor main FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke also passed with output editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-v1: editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > detail-table. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, multi-run rich-inline editing beyond first text run replacement, field-chip editing, table/media/columns text authoring, document v4 insert semantics, generic node add paths, durable draft persistence, collaboration, large-document authoring performance readiness, accessibility readiness, exact layout readiness, export parity, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor npm install reported 5 high severity audit findings and Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; neither was remediated in this lane. After merge, branch fd-ed-text-typing-0830 was deleted and Git no longer lists C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/flowdoc-vnext-editor/.worktrees/fd-ed-text-typing-0830 as a worktree, but that folder remains on disk after git worktree remove failed with Directory not empty. Direct recursive deletion was intentionally avoided. Older retained worktree cleanup risks remain separate.
